flags.why: Standalone nực meaning hot is mainly Central and Southern usage, as documented in this [regional vocabulary comparison](https://www.thuvienlamdong.org.vn/Files/Books/163080.pdf).

Gia tăng belongs mainly to formal speech and writing, so the missing warning encourages an inappropriate casual register ([dictionary usage guidance](https://vdict.com/gia%20t%C4%83ng%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
